q: Compare last week's performance against this week and identify the likely causes.

checks.what: tool: compares against last week or same weekdays last week

answer:
Net sales (order-date, Tilting Heads) fell to ₹1,51,732 this week-to-date (2026-10-12..2026-10-14) from ₹6,45,611 last week (2026-10-05..2026-10-11). Measured.

Evidence (previous → current; all measured)
- Net sales (order-date): ₹6,45,611 → ₹1,51,732. Measured  
- Orders (order-date): 339 → 81. Measured  
- Ad spend (P&L / order-date basis): ₹4,30,736 → ₹1,04,756. Measured  
- Net profit (P&L): ₹-65,119 → ₹-1,180. Measured  
- Net ROAS (P&L): 0.85x → 0.99x. Measured

What the diagnosis found (likely causes; labels from the statistical check)
- Supported cause (diagnosed): Funnel purchases fell sharply in the event window (2026-10-12..2026-10-13) and the engine estimates this explains most of the change in P&L ad-spend (≈₹31k effect on ad-spend, 95% range reported). Measured / supported_cause.  
- Correlated moves (not proven causes): Sessions dropped (11,011 → 6,688 on 2026-10-12..13) and conversion mix shifted (conversion 0.95% → 0.77%); several ad names/campaigns lost volume (e.g. TH-222-WINGBIRD and TH-149-SCRATCHLOUNGE showed big drops). These are observed associations — labelled “moved together” / insufficient evidence to call them causes. Measured / correlation.  
- No supported upstream cause was found for the headline drops in net sales, orders, net profit or net ROAS beyond the funnel-purchases signal; the diagnostic passed placebo/refuter checks and therefore reports low causal confidence except for the funnel-purchases → ad-spend link. Insufficient_evidence.

Context & notes: Comparison = 2026-10-05..2026-10-11 vs 2026-10-12..2026-10-14 (diagnostics used 2026-10-12..2026-10-13 and excluded 2026-10-14 because it’s partial) · Brand: Tilting Heads · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14.
